summary: Charts drawn with Apache ECharts — bar, line, pie, donut, rose and scatter plots over data given inline or as a table, one chart or several shown as tabs. Succeeds L0173.
in_scope: Bar charts: grouped, stacked, horizontal, with per-bar colours and value labels
Line charts: over categories, or over numbers and dates; smooth, stepped, filled, with gaps for missing values
Scatter plots, with named and labelled points
Combined bar and line charts, with a second value axis
Linear, logarithmic, category and time axes, with bounds
Data as a table with named columns that several charts share
Several charts in one collection, shown as tabs
Titles, legends, tooltips, colours, palettes and a dark theme
out_of_scope: Fetching or transforming data from a URL, a file or a spreadsheet is not built yet — L0184 plots only the data given in the request; L0170 fetches and transforms data.
Histograms, box plots, candlesticks, heatmaps, funnels, gauges and radar charts are not built yet.
Reference lines, trend lines, annotations and colour scales driven by data are not built yet.
Network charts (graph, sankey, tree, treemap, sunburst) and geographic maps are not built yet.
Spreadsheets and editable tables are L0179; do NOT route them here.
Concept maps, mind maps and other diagrams are L0183, and Venn diagrams are L0171; do NOT route them here.
Quiz questions and assessment items do NOT belong here — use L0180, or L0176 when the user names Learnosity.
L0184 does NOT accept L0173 programs: it is a different language, and existing L0173 items stay with L0173.
